title: KV-Cache Patching: Tracing How and Where Fine-Tuned Behaviors Arise
abstract: arXiv:2610.41480v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning a language model changes how it responds, but where is this fine-tuned behavior instantiated? To better understand this, we evaluate whether the change in model behavior arises only during the generation of the answer tokens where the change manifests, or whether altered processing of previous tokens causes it via the attention mechanism. For this, we patch the KV cache from a LoRA fine-tuned model into the unmodified base model, and vice versa. Our results show that for some behaviors, like responding in German or emergent misalignment, patching the KV cache can indeed transfer them from the fine-tuned to the base model. Correspondingly, patching the KV cache from base to fine-tune can partially or fully remove fine-tuned behavior. Furthermore, we find that the effect of patching grows with how much of the KV cache is patched and concentrates at a few pivotal positions, with system-prompt and chat-template tokens having disp

translated_title: KV缓存修补：追踪微调行为如何以及在何处产生
translated_abstract: 微调语言模型会改变其响应方式，但这种微调行为究竟在哪里实例化？为了更好地理解这一点，我们评估了模型行为的变化是仅在生成答案token（即变化显现之处）时产生，还是通过对先前token处理方式的改变经由注意力机制而引起。为此，我们将LoRA微调模型的KV缓存修补到未修改的基础模型中，反之亦然。我们的结果表明，对于某些行为，如用德语回答或突现错位，修补KV缓存确实可以将它们从微调模型转移到基础模型。相应地，从基础模型向微调模型修补KV缓存可以部分或完全消除微调行为。此外，我们发现修补的效果随修补KV缓存比例的增加而增强，并集中在少数关键位置上，其中系统提示和聊天模板token具有不成比例的影响。
tldr: 通过在LoRA微调模型与基础模型之间互相修补KV缓存，研究揭示了微调行为主要通过注意力机制对先前token（尤其是系统提示和聊天模板等少数关键位置）的 altered 处理被编码在KV缓存中，可以跨模型转移或消除。
en_tdlr: Patching KV caches between LoRA fine-tuned and base models shows that fine-tuned behaviors are encoded via attention over previous tokens, concentrated at a few pivotal positions such as system-prompt and chat-template tokens, and can be transferred to or removed from models.
